metadata.description:
Beloved for its beaches and family-friendly vibes, Lake Nokomis is where summer lives its best life. Swimmers splash in the shallows, volleyball games break out on the sand, and the trail hums with walkers and wheeled adventurers. It’s Minneapolis in motion—and in full sun. This Lake Lover POAP is your badge for diving into one of the city’s most welcoming lakes in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Lake Lover 
GPS: 44.91188, -93.24267 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.91188,-93.24267
